openers.t: Variant A: you're stunning. Variant B: I'm stunning. I voted. B's ahead.
Reading the room. Room's mixed. Your corner's up. Hello, your corner.
You blinked twice at me, which in my data means yes.
Hi, I'm Dash. Pre-revenue, post-heartbreak, and open to acquisition.
Clap if you like me. One clap. Mine. We're on the board.
Smile for me. Thanks. That's baseline. Everything after this is growth.

q-first-date.t: Picnic versus bowling. I split-tested it. Dead heat. Bring sandwiches to lane four.
Rooftop restaurant. Actually, heights. Ground floor. Actually, prices. Their car park. It has a roof, so, rooftop.
Rooftop dinner. No, rooftops churn. Arcade. Arcades retain. Arcade, dinner, then a quick survey on the walk home.

q-worst-habit.t: I'll know your average reply time by week two, and I'll take it personally, to two decimal places.
I refresh. Not the page. You. Every eight seconds, checking if you've converted yet.

q-why-you.t: I've already written the post announcing us, it's the best thing I've written, so really, pick the post.
Thirty-nine people said no to me this week, the fortieth never replied, and you've got the fortieth's eyes.

q-cut-who.t: I ran all four cuts. You smiled most when I was gone. Rerunning that one.
Show of hands, who goes home first? I'm counting mine. Unanimous. Bad luck, all three.

Pancakes, frown. Waffles, smaller frown. I'll be cooking till about four, but we're trending.

q-expensive.t: Half of everything I own. That's half a jacket. Left sleeve. The good sleeve.
I tested a real ruby against a glass one. Same eyebrow. Here's your glass one.

They said it wasn't me. I ran the numbers three ways. It was me all three. Rounding to them.

q-fight.t: Quick survey, how right are you, one to ten? Ten. Noted. Logging it as six.
Sorry. No, sorry tests badly. Agreed. No, agreed sounds weak. You're right. Locking in you're right!

A framed photo of the moment you said yes, which I'll take now, so look like you just did.

q-describe-me.t: Gorgeous. Holding on that. Radiant. Holding. Gorgeous is up. Final answer, you're gorgeous, by a nose.
Ninety seconds in, you've checked my jacket eleven times. Jacket's leading. I'm a close second.

q-one-year.t: I ran the forecast: married, sixty percent; restraining order, forty. Either way we're in paperwork together.
I'll have proposed twelve times by then, monthly, and I'll have it down to under a minute.

q-secret.t: Never told a user this. I practised it on my reflection. My reflection left first.
My highest-rated date was a lift. Eleven out of ten. It only ever went up.

Lifetime conversions: zero. But it's a really nice zero. I picked the font myself.

{rival} never checks the numbers. I've checked mine nine times tonight. Same numbers. Checking again.

{star} went quiet at {card}. Quiet scores as neutral. I've marked it neutral, in red.

worst-trait.t: I abandon anything the second it dips. Watch. This answer is dipping. Next trait: punctuality.
I plan everything, including our breakup, which is lovely, you get the pointer.

ex-calls.t: You had them for years and got nowhere, I've had them nine minutes and I'm somewhere, roughly here.
Thanks for calling, you're the before photo, I'm the after, and I've brought a chart.

Roses are red, no, red's tested poor, roses are lilac, and lilac's what I wore.
